integrity: The infinite theorem is proved algebraically. Finite computation is used only as an independent replay over a bounded sample. The closest source statements were compared at theorem level, including the 2025 Pell formulas, the \(d=7\) example, and the 2026 least-common-base theorem.
scientific_limitations: Optimizes the integer base only for the two fixed Pell generating-function extraction formulas; it does not claim globally shortest arithmetic terms or straight-line programs.
title: Sharp coordinate-wise extraction bases for Pell solutions
